$comment: Time-boxed exceptions for the dependency audit gate. Every entry needs id, reason, tracking and expires; see docs/ci/dependency-audit.md.

exceptions.reason: Pre-existing. axios arrives transitively via @stellar/stellar-sdk and the wallet kit; the advisory is in the Node HTTP adapter with proxy settings, while the browser bundle uses the XHR/fetch adapter. Remove once the upstream SDKs ship a patched axios.
